title: Elaboration of NMT and GSM Standards: From Idea to Market
version: University of Jyväskylä dissertation, 2002; pp. 202–203 and front matter inspected 2026-11-09
lineage: University study distinguishes Radiolinja and Vodafone opening networks in December 1991 from June 1992 availability of interim-approved terminals, which it calls actual commercial launch. Dates of early commercial service vary by definition.
